name: State (MOE)
notes: Shared Ministry of Education calendar followed by the large majority of Christchurch state and state-integrated schools. Compiled 28 June 2026. T1 start and T4 end vary by school; secondary often finishes earlier.

name: St Andrew's College (StAC)
notes: Independent school with its own calendar. Autumn break runs a week longer than state; winter starts a week earlier. Compiled 28 June 2026.
